scenario.description: A discussion arises in a shared living space about maintaining a comfortable noise environment.

agent_a.goal: Convince your roommate to lower the noise (<extra_info>Extra information: you have an important online meeting tomorrow morning and you need a quiet environment to prepare</extra_info>)
